title: Autopoies Browser Connect site adapter
description: YAML adapter that defines a named command for a website. Loaded by ap-browser CLI at runtime from ~/.ap-browser/sites/<site>/<cmd>.yaml. This schema is intentionally permissive about optional fields — it mirrors what real adapters in production use.

site.description: Site folder name; must match the parent directory. E.g. 'hackernews', 'bilibili'.

name.description: Command name; must match the YAML filename without extension. E.g. 'top', 'search'.

description.description: One-line human-readable summary of what this command does.

domain.description: Optional. Canonical domain for the site, e.g. 'news.ycombinator.com'. Used for documentation and routing; not enforced at runtime.

args.description: Declared arguments. Each key is the arg name; value is an arg definition. May be omitted if the command takes no args.

input.description: Optional pipe-input spec. When present, the adapter accepts NDJSON from stdin and auto-maps fields to args.

output.description: Optional output declaration. Declares shape so downstream pipe consumers can validate.

timeout.description: Optional max seconds for the adapter request. Overrides the default estimate (min 30s); use for slow/fast adapters.

columns.description: Optional. Column labels for human-readable output. Legacy field retained for backwards compatibility.

long_running.description: Optional. Mark as a long-running operation so CLI and agents know wait-until-done is recommended.

wait_strategy.description: Optional default wait-until-done strategy for this command when --wait is requested.

hints.description: Optional custom agent guidance hints for different lifecycle states.

steps.description: Ordered list of step primitives. Each step is a single-key object mapping method name to params.

default.description: Default value if the argument is omitted. Type depends on `type`.

field.description: Arg name to fill from each NDJSON record's same-named field. If omitted, the raw line is passed as the hidden `_input` argument.

default.description: Default value for the input field if the NDJSON record is missing it.

type.description: Output shape. Common values: 'array' (each step result is a row), 'object' (single object), 'ndjson' (raw NDJSON passthrough).

fields.description: Expected field names when type is 'array' or 'object'. Helps downstream pipe consumers validate.

goto.description: Navigate to URL (supports {{args.x}} templates). String URL or object with url/headers.

wait.description: Wait for a CSS selector, element removal (gone), or JavaScript condition (eval/until_eval) to settle. String selector or object with selector/eval/until_eval/when/gone/timeout_ms/interval_ms.

eval.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate via CDP. May reference an external .js file in the same directory.

text.description: Extract text content from a CSS selector.

html.description: Extract HTML from a CSS selector.

click.description: Click an element matching a CSS selector.

select.description: Pick an option from a native <select>. Object with selector and option (value or visible label).

batch.description: Sub-batch of steps (nested). Each item follows the step schema.

download.description: Trigger a download via the CLI's download routing.
